# [EPIC] TMDB v3 API Clone Facade & Filmpire React App Integration

## Epic
Expose a TMDB v3-shaped API from the gateway — read-through/save-through to MongoDB and PostgreSQL with a Redis cache, falling back to the real TMDB — so the Filmpire React app works as a drop-in replacement by only changing its base URL. Authentication and account calls proxy straight to the real TMDB.

## Business Value
Proves the platform end-to-end through a real frontend, not just curl/Postman — the strongest demo of the whole backend, while still supporting real TMDB login/favorites/watchlist.

## Product Goal alignment
Directly serves the [Product Goal](../../docs/process/PRODUCT_GOAL.md): a self-hosted, TMDB-shaped microservices platform real enough to run and demo.

## Notes
- Reference: ARCHITECTURE.md §5.1.
- Stays open: #38 (Playwright browser E2E) and #44 (facade hardening — single-flight for list/search misses, catalog growth policy) are open TMDB-facade work that reference this area but aren't yet organized under a Story — this epic's scope can still grow to absorb them.
